description: This file defines the 'Template' controller class in the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing template translations. It includes methods for generating translation tasks, writing translation data to files, and clearing generated translation files.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: Controller class for managing template translations in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates and schedules translation tasks for templates across stores and languages.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Generates translation JSON files based on stored translations, writes them to the filesystem.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated translation files for all stores and languages.
